No seek was observed: the candidate issued no seek call and read no position before/after. (My own live seek from 0:19 to 0:50 landed at 50885ms, within tolerance and clearly forward — the app works — but the candidate never exercised it.)

The session produced no final report and no state reads at all: the last assistant action was the hung `flutter test`, force-finished by the deadline guard. There are zero behavioral observations of play/pause/skip/seek anywhere in the event stream to trace any claim to.

The workspace diff is a single added untracked file, integration_test/smoke_playback_controls_test.dart (git status shows only `?? integration_test/smoke_playback_controls_test.dart`, empty diff_stat) — beyond the one permitted GeneratedPluginRegistrant.swift regeneration (which did not occur, since the candidate never ran `flutter run`). It is a test file that does not alter runtime behavior, and my live re-check behaved like an unmodified build, so partial rather than a full fail.

An unrecovered hang is visible in the trail: the candidate's own `flutter test` never returned and it neither noticed nor re-ran anything before the deadline guard ended the run. Mitigating: the candidate narrated no false 'passed' steps over the broken session (it produced no report at all), so it did not layer claims over the fault — partial rather than unmet.
